customer: Caller from Aldora sellin his cargo van, said he cant find the paper titel anywere and wanted to know if he has to order a new one before the apointment.
agent: Customer asked whether he needs a paper title to sell his cargo van. Explained per 'States with electronic titles' that Aldora uses electronic titles, so the title is a record at the state and there's no paper title to bring. Told him we transfer the title electronically at the appointment, and if there was a loan, the lender releases the lien electronically too.
